_comment: Pinned toolchain for the XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense build (next gen, blinky-firmware#50; docs/NEXTGEN_ESP32S3_PLAN.md). Same rules as tools/firmware_toolchain.json (the nRF52840 fleet's): scripts/setup_toolchain.sh --target esp32s3 installs exactly this into <repo>/.arduino-esp32s3, scripts/build.sh --esp32 compiles only there, and tools/check_build_libs.py --target esp32s3 refuses drift. FQBN: OPI PSRAM on, Hardware CDC (USB Serial/JTAG) console, and the default_8MB partition table: nvs 0x9000 (settings + device config), otadata 0xe000, two 3.2 MB OTA app slots at 0x10000 and 0x340000 (OTA with rollback later, no repartition), spiffs 0x670000, coredump 0x7f0000. No TFLite: the onset NN is off on devices, and the S3's NN (ESP-NN kernels) is the later P3 investigation.
